senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; <cite ref="R00727"><he>צַר</he></cite>) fem. of <cite ref="R00727"><he>צַר</he></cite>.

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 9b:7">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>דיה לצ׳ בשעתה</he> time enough for the trouble when it comes (‘sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof’).

<cite ref="Berakhot 63a:22">Ib. 63ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 24:10">Prov. XXIV, 10</cite>) <he>כל המרפה … ביום צ׳</he> he who neglects the words of the Law, has no strength on the day of trouble.
<cite ref="Pesachim 117a:20">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>על כל צ׳ וצ׳ וכ׳</he> in every trouble that may not come (euphem. for: that comes) upon them.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:15">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (from Ben Sira) <he>אל תצר צָרת מחר וכ׳</he> worry not about to-morrow’s trouble, for thou knowest not what the day may beget.

<cite ref="Sotah 12a:7">Sot. 12ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>צֶרֶת</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:7">I Chr. IV, 7</cite>) <he>שנעשית צ׳ וכ׳</he> because she was a trouble (an object of envy) to her companions.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5">Snh. IV, 5</cite> <he>שמא תאמרו מה לנו ולצ׳ וכ׳</he> lest you say, why should we undergo this trouble (of giving testimony)? &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81:2">Gen. R. s. 81</cite> <he>וכיון שראה שצָרָתוֹ צ׳</he> and when he saw that his trouble was a real trouble (when he felt greatly embarrassed).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אל תזכירני צָרָתִיִ</he> do not cause me to mention my trouble.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 21:2">Is. XXI, 2</cite>) <he>כבר נתעלה צָרָתָהּ של עילם … כבר נוצרה צרתה וכ׳</he> (not <he>נתעלם</he>) the anguish which Elam has to bring has already been brought up (prepared), … the anguish through Media has already been created; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>צָרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:3">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ אחרונות וכ׳</he> the later troubles make us forget the earlier; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:12:4">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:5:3">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵈ</cite> <he>לא דיינו הצ׳ … צרתו של המן</he> have we not enough with the persecutions that visit us (on account of which we hold fast-days), that you want to impose upon us (the fast in commemoration of) the persecution by Haman? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.
